name: POS Product Category in Receipt
description: The Product Category in Receipt app for Odoo POS enhances receipts by automatically displaying each product’s category along with its details. This makes it easier for businesses and customers to quickly identify and organize purchased items.
summary: This app enhances the Point of Sale (POS) system by displaying the product category on the receipt. It automatically categorizes items purchased, making it easy for customers to identify the types of products they’ve bought. By adding a clear product category label, the receipt becomes more informative and organized, improving the overall customer experience. By categorizing items at the point of sale, the app not only helps customers easily identify their purchased products but also provides businesses with better record-keeping capabilities. The clear categorization of items improves the overall transaction experience, as receipts become more user-friendly and transparent. For businesses, this feature is essential for streamlining inventory management, tracking sales data by category, and improving overall customer service. This feature is especially useful for businesses with diverse inventories, offering clarity and better record-keeping. This app is designed to improve the functionality of a Point of Sale (POS) system by automatically displaying the product category on customer receipts.
